mapper.sql: r.id, r.owner_id, u.username, u.display_name, r.request_id, r.conversation_id, r.user_message_id, r.assistant_message_id, r.question, r.status, r.execution_mode, r.model_id, r.provider, r.model, r.candidate_count, r.evidence_count, r.degraded, r.error_code, r.started_at, r.first_token_at, r.completed_at, r.total_ms, r.end_to_end_ttft_ms, r.model_ttft_ms, r.first_reasoning_ms, r.first_answer_ms
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rag_runs r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_id
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status <> 'RUNNING') AS terminal_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED') AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status <> 'RUNNING' AND r.degraded) AS degraded_count, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.total_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.total_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS total_p50_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.total_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.total_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS total_p95_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.end_to_end_ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.end_to_end_ttft_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS end_to_end_ttft_p50_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.end_to_end_ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.end_to_end_ttft_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS end_to_end_ttft_p95_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.model_ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.model_ttft_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS model_ttft_p50_ms, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.model_ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE r.model_ttft_ms IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS model_ttft_p95_ms FROM rag_runs r
